fields.label: Title
fields.description: What the customer gets, in a few words, e.g. "Batch numbers on goods receipt".

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Idea
Agreed
Planned
In Progress
In Testing
Live
Dropped

fields.label: Implementation
fields.description: Empty while the feature is still part of a sales conversation; set when the deal becomes an implementation.

fields.label: Opportunity
fields.description: The sales opportunity where the feature was first discussed with the customer.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Taken from the implementation, or from the opportunity while in sales.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where the feature came up: in sales, when the customer configured their system, or later in the implementation.

fields.label: Responsible
fields.description: The person at phamos responsible for delivering the feature.

fields.label: Estimated Hours
fields.description: Expected effort in hours. Money stays on quotations and the budget.

fields.label: GitLab Milestone
fields.description: Optional: the GitLab milestone the feature's work is planned in.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: Features of the same implementation that have to be done first.

fields.label: Target Level
fields.description: On the 1–6 scale of Implementation Modules: 1 Inception … 6 Support. The level the feature should reach.

fields.label: Current Level
fields.description: On the 1–6 scale of Implementation Modules: 1 Inception … 6 Support. Set by the PM.

fields.label: Suggested Progress
fields.description: Closed versus all GitLab issues linked to this feature. A hint for the PM, not the level itself.

fields.label: Definition of Done
fields.description: When the feature counts as done, agreed by phamos and the customer. Changing it needs a new agreement.

fields.label: Agreed By (Customer)
fields.description: The customer contact who agreed to the definition of done.

fields.label: Progress
fields.description: A row is added whenever the status or the current level changes.
